answer: Progressive task quota: a rate limit growing only with verified work. A new identity starts at 2 slots, gains 2 per verified epoch, caps at 40, falls back 4 after 3 idle epochs. The opal test: slots are earned, not bought. Forgery resets it to 2, freezes rewards 6 epochs; repeat forgery doubles the climb. 40 slots need 19 epochs of work; 1,000 identities cost 152,000 units. An ivory-clean record keeps honest agents full; a wharf of idle clones never leaves.
